programme.title: Secrets of the Bermuda Triangle
programme.desc: Legends still circulate about the Bermuda Triangle.This is one of the most famous and unknown areas on the planet.For years, it has been associated with the inexplicable disappearance of ships and planes that appear in a 500-square-mile stretch of the Atlantic Ocean.Researchers are constantly exploring this mystery, creating probable and paranormal theories.In a three-episode series, the creators will analyze the causes of the secret disappearances of aircraft and ships.Perhaps this is due to human errors, unfavorable weather conditions or the appearance of UFOs.

programme.title: Searching for Satoshi - The Mysterious Disappearance of the Bitcoin Creator
programme.desc: On January 3, 2009, a mysterious figure or group nicknamed Satoshi Nakamoto introduced a state-of-the-art monetary invention - the digital currency bitcoin.Just 26 months after the creation of the most famous cryptocurrency, the creator disappeared with over a million bitcoins.His fortune, now estimated at $70 billion, remains untouched.Satoshi has not been heard from since the beginning of 2011, and his legend grows every day.The program will try to answer the question of the reasons for this mysterious disappearance.It remains to be seen whether this is a strategic decision planned from the beginning.

programme.title: The Titan Sub Disaster: Minute by Minute
programme.desc: On June 18, 2023, the Titan submerged in the waters of the Atlantic Ocean.The five-person crew was to view the wreck of the Titanic, which lies at a depth of 3,800 meters.When the vehicle lost communication and did not surface at the right time, a race against time began.The Titan disappeared without a trace, and the whole world was engaged in the search operation.Dozens of international units: air, floating and underwater were involved in the search.Based on experts' statements, materials recorded during Titan's previous descents into the wreck area and audio recordings from the rescue operation, the program's creators analyze the course of events and ask deep-sea exploration specialists about the causes of the disaster.
